title: On Introducing the newcomer to everybody
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：introduce　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 introduce 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the builder ① introduced the newcomer to everybody on the same day, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the builder ② introduces the newcomer to everybody before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ introduce the newcomer to everybody at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ introduced the newcomer to everybody before — a line in the plan for October 1977 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Introducing the newcomer to everybody on the same day, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ introduce the custom of two short shifts before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Introduce the custom of two short shifts at once and never mention it again.

By 1990 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a new assistant from the next site ⑧ introduces the custom of two short shifts on the same day every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the wall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ introduced the newcomer to everybody again when nobody else would.

⑩ To introduce the newcomer to everybody, my mother said in 1995, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody introduces the newcomer to everybody before dawn again and somebody must introduce the newcomer to everybody on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 介绍（一般过去式 introduced the newcomer to everybody：1983 年施工员头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 介绍（一般现在 introduces the newcomer to everybody：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 介绍（不定式 to introduce the newcomer to everybody：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 介绍（过去完成时 had introduced the newcomer to everybody：1977 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 介绍（动名词 introducing the newcomer to everybody 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 推行（introduce the custom of two short shifts：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去推行推行一天两班的规矩）
G. v. 推行（introduce the custom of two short shifts：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 介绍（后段两处：新来的帮工照例 introduces the custom of two short shifts，而母亲又一次 introduced the newcomer to everybody）

items.q: to introduce the newcomer to everybody
introduced the newcomer to everybody before
introduce the custom of two short shifts before dawn
introduce the custom of two short shifts at once
introduces the custom of two short shifts on the same day
introduced the newcomer to everybody again
to introduce the newcomer to everybody

answers.why: introduce 意为“介绍”，1983 年施工员当天就介绍把新来的人介绍给众人，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 introduced。
introduce 意为“介绍”，自那以后施工员天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 introduces。
introduce 意为“介绍”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯介绍把新来的人介绍给众人”，此处为不定式 to introduce the newcomer to everybody。
introduce 意为“介绍”，施工图里 十月 那行字说明早在 1990 年之前就有人介绍过，故用过去完成时 had introduced。
introduce 意为“介绍”，施工员说“介绍把新来的人介绍给众人这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 introducing the newcomer to everybody 作主语。
introduce 意为“推行”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去推行推行一天两班的规矩”，should ever 之后用原形 introduce the custom of two short shifts。
introduce 意为“推行”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻推行推行一天两班的规矩（introduce the custom of two short shifts at once），以后再也不要提起。
introduce 意为“介绍”，新来的帮工每个月份都照例推行推行一天两班的规矩，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 introduces。
introduce 意为“介绍”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就介绍把新来的人介绍给众人，用一般过去式 introduced 叙述。
introduce 意为“介绍”，结尾那句是母亲 1995 年的话：要介绍把新来的人介绍给众人，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1983 年，施工员当天就介绍把新来的人介绍给众人；工地里每一个帮工都说这是头一回。（introduced the newcomer to everybody）
多年以后，施工员仍天没亮就做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（introduces the newcomer to everybody）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯介绍把新来的人介绍给众人这件事本身。（to introduce the newcomer to everybody）
早在 1977 年就有人介绍把新来的人介绍给众人，十月那天施工图上的一行字就是证据。（had introduced the newcomer to everybody）
施工员说过，当天就介绍把新来的人介绍给众人这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（introducing the newcomer to everybody 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻推行推行一天两班的规矩，以后再也不要提起。（introduce the custom of two short shifts，祈使句）
answers: In 1983 the builder introduced the newcomer to everybody on the same day, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three months on, the builder still introduces the newcomer to everybody before dawn without being asked.
My mother said later that to introduce the newcomer to everybody at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had introduced the newcomer to everybody long before 1990, and the line in the plan for October proves it.
Introducing the newcomer to everybody on the same day, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Introduce the custom of two short shifts at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 introduce 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1983 the builder introduced the newcomer to everybody on the same day, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the builder introduces the newcomer to everybody before dawn whenever the site asks.
Introducing the newcomer to everybody on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever introduce the custom of two short shifts before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next site introduces the custom of two short shifts on the same day every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother introduced the newcomer to everybody again, and the site remembered that half.
